title: Local-time labels for the line chart's time axis
goal: A consumer gets time labels in the viewer's zone without shifting its data
acceptance: bx-line-chart can format a time axis in local time (axis ticks, point readout, desc and data table); the default and the option are recorded in docs/decisions/charts.md
Unit tests that hold in any test-machine time zone (expectations built with the local Date getters)
Catalogue example; changelog entry under Unreleased
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One formatter and one input on an existing component. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
